Coram : D.Y. CHANDRACHUD*, HEMANT GUPTA
Auction – Commercial property – Willful default by buyer – Appellant was allotted booth in open auction for Rs.7,55,000/- – Appellant paid Rs. 1,88,750/- (25% of the sale consideration) but failed to make payment of the remaining sale consideration Officer, Haryana Urban Development Authority) passed resumption order and resumed the booth on account of non- payment of dues – Appeal filed by the appellant – Resumption order set aside – Pursuant to the appellate order, the appellant paid Rs.7,00,000/- – Revision filed
Decision Date : 21-02-2019 | Case No : CIVIL APPEAL No. 1932/2019 | Disposal Nature : Disposed off | Bench : 2 Judges
